subject: N311 execution-context integrity Candidate correction
boundedQuestion: Can a Producer claim the anchored execution context while the independently observed runtime context differs?

vulnerableReplay.defect: N311 hashes caller-supplied context but has no independent observation, observer identity, raw-evidence digest, or subject binding.

teacherDecision.source: N307 browser-observed route receipt and its W3C/WPT method teacher
teacherDecision.reason: Independent observation and self-report conflict handling already exist in KAOPU Current Best View; N312 exposes a missing transfer from N307 into N311.

boundary: Synthetic protocol replay only. It does not prove a real Mother has a trustworthy observer for every context field, and it does not make browser evidence equivalent to physical-device or user acceptance.
